name: ghost-v5-on-heroku
description: Deploy latest ghost v5 on Heroku
author: thelovekesh <hi@thelovekesh.com>

scripts.postinstall: node bin/install-ghost.mjs && yarn install --cwd ghost && bash bin/aws-s3.sh
scripts.heroku-postbuild: mkdir -p content/adapters && rm -rf content/adapters/cloudinary && cp -R node_modules/ghost-storage-cloudinary content/adapters/cloudinary && mkdir -p /tmp/casper && curl -L -o /tmp/casper.tgz https://github.com/TryGhost/Casper/archive/refs/tags/5.8.1.tar.gz && tar -xzf /tmp/casper.tgz -C /tmp/casper && rm -rf content/themes/casper && mkdir -p content/themes && mv /tmp/casper/Casper-5.8.1 content/themes/casper
